content: Official BIOP author (NicoKiaru) example gist confirms the canonical pattern: pixelToAtlasTransform = AtlasTools.getAtlasToPixelTransform(imageData).inverse(); then for each detection build a net.imglib2.RealPoint(3) from (centroidX, centroidY, 0), and call pixelToAtlasTransform.apply(point, point) in place. Resulting coordinates are conventionally stored as measurements named Atlas_X/Atlas_Y/Atlas_Z. Matches installed-jar-verified InvertibleRealTransform.inverse()/apply(RealLocalizable,RealPositionable) API.
